_comment: Pilot config. Purpose is harness and reporting validation, NOT results. Two cells testing decision rule only, on cheap paid models. See _caveats.

_caveats.confounded: consensus is paired with round_robin and advisory with fixed_leader, so an outcome difference cannot be attributed to either factor. This reproduces the bundling the original repo had. Acceptable here because the pilot tests plumbing, not hypotheses. Use configs/ablations.json for the crossed grid.
_caveats.models: Cheap paid models (~$0.07/game across the trio; a 20-game validation run is ~$1.50). Paid rather than free tier because the binding constraint on free tier is wall-clock, not cost: 20 req/min turns even a short pilot into a 13-hour run. These are still non-reasoning models and would likely fail the eligibility gate, so expect elevated illegal-move rates. For validation that is useful — it exercises the illegal-move, false-consensus and resolution-fallback paths that stronger models rarely touch.
_caveats.not_for_results: Nothing produced under this config should be reported as a finding.
_caveats.scale: Use --limit-positions to size the run. Validation needs a handful of positions, not the full set; 5 positions x 2 cells x 2 colours = 20 games is ample to exercise every path.
